note: Tensorize lifts legacy code to tensor DSLs, a problem domain directly comparable to Helium's lifting of stencil kernels to Halide; the abstract references 'prior efforts' it outperforms, and Helium is a canonical prior effort in this space, likely cited for positioning/comparison.
title: Tensorize: Fast Synthesis of Tensor Programs from Legacy Code using Symbolic Tracing, Sketching and Solving
